## Checklist

- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` has a new entry under `Unreleased` describing this change.
- [ ] SBOM will be regenerated by the release workflow (no action needed here unless you changed
      a dependency - if you did, confirm the lockfile is committed and pinned exactly).
- [ ] Tests added or updated, and the full suite passes locally.
- [ ] No secrets, live credentials, real hostnames, or customer data in code, tests, sample
      output, or screenshots.
- [ ] Docs updated (`README.md` and/or `docs/`) if this changes behaviour a user would notice.
- [ ] Commits are signed off (`git commit -s`) per the DCO requirement in `CONTRIBUTING.md`.
